title.zh-TW: 送出按鈕的載入與結果

summary.zh-TW: 按下送出後，按鈕縮成方塊、裡面的小方塊開始轉；成功時撐回原本寬度並打勾，失敗時變紅並左右搖晃。勾選下方的選項就能試失敗的情況。
summary.en: Pressing Send shrinks the button into a square with a small spinning square inside; on success it widens back with a check, on failure it turns red and shakes. Tick the option below to try a failure.

text.zh-TW: GSAP 的動畫可以用 await 等它播完。流程就能照順序寫：先縮成方塊 → 等送出結果 → 再播成功或失敗，不用一層一層包 callback。
text.en: GSAP animations can be awaited. The flow reads top to bottom — shrink to a square, wait for the result, then play success or failure — without nested callbacks.

text.zh-TW: 寬度動畫會觸發重新排版，但只影響這一顆按鈕，可以接受。原本的寬度先量好存起來，變回來時才知道要回到多寬。
text.en: Animating width triggers layout, but only for this one button, which is fine. The original width is measured once so it knows how wide to return.

text.zh-TW: 載入中的小方塊無限旋轉，ease 用 none 才會等速轉。結束時要 kill() 停掉，不然會在背景一直轉。
text.en: The loading square spins forever; ease none keeps the speed constant. kill() it when done, or it keeps spinning in the background.

text.zh-TW: 送出中再點不會重複送出（防止重複下單），讀屏軟體也會知道按鈕正在忙。結果用 role="status" 的文字唸出來。
text.en: While busy, extra clicks are ignored (no double submissions) and screen readers know the button is busy. The result is announced through a role="status" element.

text.zh-TW: 失敗的紅色交給 CSS 過渡，GSAP 只管大小和位置。這樣亮暗模式切換時顏色也會正確。
text.en: The red failure colour is a CSS transition; GSAP only handles size and position, so colours stay correct across light and dark mode.
